While this site may not seem like much, its biggest advantage lies in the fact that those fat AT-ATs won't be able to deploy or move in here, giving you as the Light player an advantage and a way to avoid the terror that is [[Tempest 1]] piloted by Igar. Late in the game, you could even throw this site out to put an end to the cat and mouse scenario. After chasing you all game, lead the mechaniks to on end of the [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]] site chain and then dump this nexst door. Your opponent's fat walker won't be able to move past, allowing you to segment your characters in their safe little haven, spread to drain, and dare him to se4nd his characters in without their big blue support.
